messages:
marta: Quick follow-up from the precision-profiles RFC — how should we propagate precision metadata through the operator graph? We hit a mismatch where KV-cache operators didn't get the profile id. Repro in prod canary.
kevin: thinking we should attach a minimal header to each request: `precision_profile_id` + optional `precision_hint` per op. That keeps payload tiny. Example:
```
{"precision_profile_id": "pp-fp8-lowlat-v2", "propagate": true}
```
jie: careful — per-op metadata exploded memory during the python-side tracer. prefer a pointer to a profile in shared config store + per-request TTL. don't copy full profile per op.
samir: runtime perspective: the serving hotpath can cache profile lookup by id with LRU and version check. cache miss penalty is small if we warm on canary. we also need an invariant: if profile changes mid-request, either freeze or fallback.
marta: freeze or fallback = which? freezing seems safer but might block rollouts.
kevin: propose freeze-on-read for in-flight requests, rollouts only affect new requests. add a `profile_version` stamp.
elaine: product question — do we surface per-request precision in logs/console? ops will want per-route breakdowns.
jie: yes, but scrub sensitive bits. telemetry should report `profile_id`, `version`, and `quality_score_delta` (optional).
ops-bot: deploy canary scheduled: precision-shim-v0.3 -> infra-canary (hash abc123) at 2026-03-23T15:12Z :rocket:
marta: action items: (1) Kevin to draft header schema (2) Jie to prototype store + TTL (3) Samir to add cache and version freeze (4) Elaine to spec telemetry fields. Aim: canary by EOD Friday.
kevin: I'll push a PR with schema + small test. ping me for review.
jie: I'll cobble a toy in `quant-config-store` and post perf numbers.
samir: I'll add a checksum assert in runtime to detect mid-request profile mismatch and log as `profile_frozen`.
elaine: thanks — will update the console dashboard tickets.
marta: great. if nobody objects i'll start the RFC follow-up doc with the decisions.
